text:
sam: Heads up — canary CI flagged a decode p95 regression after merge `#1234` (35% slower). logs and perf CI link: https://ci/reports/180500 -- triggering rollout-blocker tag :rotating_light:

jia: ugh, saw the alert. Is this the fused-op change that went in yesterday?

dan: running a quick perf compare now. can someone bisect locally? I don't want to wait on CI queue.

sam: starting a bisect:```bash
git bisect start HEAD v2026-04-18
git bisect run ./dev/tools/run_perf.sh --target decode-p95
```

ci-bot: perf check queued: job #4827 (canary) — p95 decode +34.8% vs baseline.

alex: quick profiler snapshot attached (flamegraph): https://storage/reports/fg-180500.svg — looks like attention fallback path dominates now.

jia: the fused-op refactor bumped kernel selection priorities to prefer fused-attn on compile path; fallback for long seqs ends up using unoptimized decode kernel. suspect selector heuristic arithmetic change.

dan: bisect results (local): commit `a9c3f2b` is the first bad. That commit touches fused_op_scheduler.cc and kv_cache_version.h

sam: kv_cache_version.h? did we intentionally bump version? that could invalidate prefix cache and force KV rewarm which spikes decode latency.

alex: checking `a9c3f2b` diff:```diff
- // kernel selector: prefer old kernel for small batch
+ // kernel selector: prefer fused kernel for memory locality
```

jia: also `kv_cache_version` macro went from 2 -> 3 in the same commit. that will cause cache misses in warm paths. two orthogonal regressions in one commit :facepalm:

ops-bot: added label `rollout-blocker` to release/2026-05-03, assigned to eng-runtime oncall.

sam: plan: revert `a9c3f2b` from canary (hotfix) and open smaller PRs: (1) separate kernel selector heuristic tweak, (2) explicit kv cache upgrade migration with safety gate. agreed?

dan: +1. I'll prepare the revert PR and a quick canary patch. also adding a test to CI that runs a short kv-cache-warm scenario and asserts decode p95 not regressed >10%.

alex: for the longer term, we should add a unit for selector decision matrix and a perf-e2e that asserts the fused vs fallback ratio doesn't flip for common seq lengths.

jia: copied profiling notes to the incident doc: https://docs/incidents/180500-decode-regression — includes perf counter dumps and microbench results.

sam: thanks. Dan, ping when the revert PR is up and I'll sign off.

dan: PR created: https://git/repo/pull/5693 revert a9c3f2b — canary patch in pipeline.

ci-bot: deploy canary revert to cluster-uk started. watch logs: https://ci/logs/5693

ops-bot: canary health: 5/5 services ok. latency p95 back within 3% of baseline after revert. :thumbsup:

sam: closing thread when we've monitored 30m but marking incident resolved for now. thanks all!
